description: Colours the patch cables in the rack from the keyboard: its panel holds a list of cables, each with a colour and a key, and pressing that key while dragging a patch cable gives the cable that colour
notes: the keys are the number keys 1 to 9 until they are changed, and they act only while a patch cable is being dragged unless key mappings are always active
once a cable is released the panel marks the colour that the next cable drawn in the rack will take
the key left of the 1 key, the backtick on a US keyboard, switches latching on and off: latched, every new cable takes the colour last chosen; unlatched, the colour moves on one place each time
right-clicking a cable on the panel opens its colour and its key for editing; holding the left button on a cable and then pressing a key assigns that key to it
dragging a cable up or down the panel reorders the list, which is the order the colours cycle through
the colours and keys are kept globally for the whole of Rack, and are written into patches and presets only when the two load and save options are turned on
one module per patch: a second one put in the rack prints the message that only one instance of this module is permitted
menu: Latch — holds the chosen colour for the next cable created; with it off the colour cycles on after each cable
` key to toggle latch mode — lets the backtick key switch latching on and off, with the key it names printed at the front of the item
Indicate selected colour — marks the currently chosen colour on the panel
Display key mappings — prints each key beside the colour it selects
Port hover mode — recolours every cable on a port when the cursor is over that port and a mapped key is pressed
Key mappings active always — lets the keys work at any time, not only while a cable is being dragged
Load/save colours from/to patches/presets — reads and writes the colours with patches and presets as well as globally
Load/save keys from/to patches/presets — reads and writes the key assignments with patches and presets as well as globally
Key mappings — opens the list of keys and their colours, with Clear all to unmap every one of them
Replace patch cable colours — recolours the cables already in the rack, taking one colour or All, and replacing with Replace for a chosen colour, Random, or Sequenced
Add cable — puts another cable on the panel to be given a colour and a key
Delete all cables — clears every cable from the panel
